named_subject: a tornado funnel (an inverted cone with a spiral top)
action: The funnel stays in place in the middle of the frame and sways slightly left and right while the cloud band and ground line behind it change from frame to frame.
identity_gap: The animated funnel uses the same wide spiral rim, open overhanging stroke at the top, and kinked left side as the doodle, so it reads as the same drawing.
notes: The funnel itself drifts only a little and stays steady, but the grey cloud band appears and disappears on alternating frames (gone in 4, 7, 9-11, 15-16) and the ground line jumps position, which makes the shot flicker; the film shows a steady cloud base over a slowly drifting funnel. The change that would help most is to keep the cloud band present in every frame and move it continuously with the camera drift instead of switching it on and off.
